senses.gloss:
रौरव रौरव, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. रुरु), made
of the hide of the deer called रुरु; fearful, dread-
ful, terrible; unsteady, cheating, fraudulent, dishonest;
(अस्), m. a savage; N. of one of the hells (Manu
IV. 88); of the fifth Kalpa; (अम्), n. the fruit of
the Ruru tree; N. of various Sāmans.

रौरवक = रुरुणा कृतम्, see Gaṇa Kulālādi
to Pāṇ. IV. 3, 118.

रौरुकिन्, इनस्, m. pl. (fr. रुरुक), the school
of Ruruka.
